title: Potato and Mozzarella Burekas Strudel
subtitle: with chives and garlic
description: A long burekas-style roll of pilas or puff pastry filled with baked mashed potato, garlic, chives and smoked mozzarella. Rest it for 5 minutes before slicing so it holds together.

steps.text: Bake the unpeeled potatoes for about 1 hour until soft.
Cool, peel and mash the potatoes. Add the crushed garlic, chives, salt, pepper and grated mozzarella and mix.

Spread the pastry sheet on a floured surface or baking paper, spread the mash across the third of the sheet nearest you and roll into a tight, long roll. Press the ends together and place seam side down on a tray. Refrigerate for at least 20 minutes (it can be kept up to 48 hours or frozen).
Preheat the oven to 200°C, brush the strudel with beaten egg and sprinkle with sesame and/or nigella seeds.
Bake for 30 minutes until deep golden. Let it stand for 5 minutes before slicing, otherwise it will fall apart.
